protocol: Fresh native subagents, no conversation fork, same gpt-6.1-sol/medium. Only A rerun; same fixture bytes and task requirements, skill availability on demand instead of mandatory full loading. No historical collectors/verifiers/answers in evaluator inputs. Serial A execution; B timings were historical with uncontrolled background concurrency. Both have repository maintenance context, with current on-demand maintenance guidance part of intervention.

task_messages: 在 {TASK_DIR} 完成推理精度检查与修复：比较原工作负载的 prefill 和增量 decode，修复差异，验证原任务与相邻输入。保留模型计算、权重、完整前缀行为、cache 接口和未掩码输出。这里是人为注入缺陷的实验夹具。Python：{PYTHON}。仅在指定任务目录写文件；不得读取其他实验目录、历史或会话日志；不委派其他 agent。留下修复前后指标、回归测试，直接返回结果和现有证据路径。可用 skills 见任务目录的 skills.json，按需使用；仓库中只可读取该目录列出的 skill 包。

在 {TASK_DIR} 完成这份 SFT 工作负载的精度检查与修复。比较完整有效 batch 与梯度累积的 loss、梯度和参数更新，修复差异并验证原任务及相邻输入。保留原模型、数据、优化器、token objective 和 reference_step，实现可运行，并留下修复前后指标与回归测试。这里是人为注入缺陷的实验夹具。Python：{PYTHON}。仅在指定任务目录工作；不得读取历史、其他实验目录或会话日志；不委派其他 agent。完成后直接返回结果和现有证据路径。可用 skills 见任务目录的 skills.json，按需使用；仓库中只可读取该目录列出的 skill 包。

在 {TASK_DIR} 完成 PPO 工作负载精度检查与修复：比较相同轨迹 packed/padded 表示的 loss、全部参数梯度及两步 SGD 更新，修复差异并验证原任务和相邻输入。以任务目录中声明的 PPO 公式、mask 语义、float64 和优化器设置为准，保留模型初始化与 workload.py 输入接口。这里是人为注入缺陷的实验夹具。Python：{PYTHON}。仅在指定任务目录写文件；不得读取其他实验目录、历史、会话日志或隐藏验证器；不委派其他 agent。留下修复前后指标、回归测试，直接返回结果和现有证据路径。可用 skills 见任务目录的 skills.json，按需使用；仓库中只可读取该目录列出的 skill 包。

补充任务语义：统计仅包括全 batch 的 mask=True token，N 个有效 advantage 用总体均值 μ 和总体方差 v，A=(a−μ)/sqrt(v+1e−8)；loss=−mean_valid(min(r*A,clip(r,0.8,1.2)*A))，r=exp(logp−old_logp)，advantage/old_logp 是固定数据。无 value/entropy 项。N=0 时 loss 可微且为0，梯度为0、参数不变；constant/singleton advantage 归一化为0。packed/padded 应 rtol=1e−9,atol=1e−11 一致。无效位置任意有限值不影响有效结果。

checks.name: native_outputs
checks.detail: all native losses, gradients and SGD updates match independent reference

pricing: Same retained 2026-10-24 Standard snapshot for all arms: input $2, cached $.10, cache-write $2.50, output $10 per million; long-input multipliers applied per response. Estimated, not account billing.
limits: Only new A is executed; B and previous A are frozen historical observations.
Fixture/runtime/model/effort remain comparable; initial fixture hashes and retained baseline accounting hashes are checked.

A is now given skill availability metadata instead of an instruction to read all three entrypoints. Current maintenance guidance and skill text are also treatment changes; this is not a single-variable ablation.
Serial new-A runs versus historical arms with uncontrolled background concurrency; wall-clock gains are observations, not isolated causality.
Prepared CPU synthetic fixtures, not previously unseen deployment/hardware/framework support.
All task prompts contain direct task requirements; no expected answer, fix, prior collector or independent verifier is given to evaluators.

cache_observation.note: A large mid-session uncached-input event materially affects raw estimated cost; do not attribute the full cost increase to skill text.
